title: Coin change (fewest coins)
statement: Return the fewest coins (unlimited supply of each denomination) summing to amount, or −1 if impossible.
hints: Greedy by largest coin fails for [1, 3, 4] and 6.
dp[a] = 1 + min over coins c ≤ a of dp[a − c].

solution.explanation: State dp[a] = the fewest coins for amount a. The last coin used is some c, leaving a − c to solve optimally (optimal substructure). Use a sentinel larger than any real answer (amount + 1) instead of infinity, which keeps C++ in ints. This is also a shortest path: amounts are nodes and coins are unit-weight edges, so BFS works.
